title: UpKeep Operator Console Deck
brands: Operator Console: the admin login where the person running UpKeep sees all member and tech info (member list/cards, member detail, tech roster and detail, search, schedule, jobs map, alerts/to-do, KPI strip, sidebar vs tabs, phone view). Desktop-first; example data, no real people.
Smart Upkeep brand: white and cream, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, Khand and Hind, light mode only.
example_data: All numbers, names and reviews on cards are labeled example data or placeholders.
